source: 1001 三月七 战技 可爱即是正义 (100102, BPSkill/Defence): 「为指定我方单体提供能够抵消等同于三月七#1[i]%防御力+#4[i]伤害的护盾，持续#2[i]回合。」 param Lv10 = [0.57, 3, 0.3, 760, 5] → #1 = 0.57, #2 = 3, #4 = 760
note: The shield: 「抵消等同于三月七 **57% 防御力 + 760** 伤害的护盾，持续 3 回合」。 ⚠ `scale: owner_def` + `amount` is the 「share plus a constant」 shape (added 2026-09-27 for this sentence): `percent` of the **rule owner's** DEFENCE plus the flat 760, computed when the rule fires and then held by the shield. The engine stores one shield value and a new shield **overwrites** it instead of stacking, which is what 「提供…护盾」 means. ⚠ The numbers are the **Lv10** row the prose quotes -- the engine's characters are all at skill level 1, so reading 「the skill's own level」 would give 0.38 + 190: the same 「which row」 question `damage_level` answers where an op reads a table, registered with M-32. ⚠ NOT written from this Skill: the taunt clause 「若该目标当前生命值百分比大于等于 30%，被敌方攻击的概率大幅提高」 -- `target_hp_percent` and the `TAUNT` op both exist now, and it is STILL not written, for a reason that is not about vocabulary: the sentence raises a **probability** (「被敌方攻击的概率大幅提高」) and the document states **no magnitude anywhere**, while `TAUNT` is a hard constraint (while it is up, a single-target attack can only pick the taunter). Using it would replace a soft weight with a hard lock -- a different mechanic, not a different number -- so it remains a registered data gap. ⚠ `turns: 3` **is** honoured now: the shield is a timed `ShieldBuff` and its duration is counted in the **shielded ally's** own turns, which is what 「持续3回合」 means. Before 2026-09-27 that field was read, validated, and then silently dropped (nothing ever took the shield off), which also made every 「持有护盾的」 clause true for the rest of the battle. ⚠ Still not written from this Skill: 行迹「加护」 (「战技提供的护盾持续时间增加<1>回合」) -- lengthening a buff that is already up has no spelling (a rule can create a shield, not extend one), and 星魂 6's 「在**战技提供的**护盾保护下」 needs the shield's provider to be askable.

source: 1001 三月七 行迹 纯洁 (1001101): 「施放战技时，解除指定我方单体的1个负面效果。」
note: Her kit is a wall of shields, and this is the one clause of it that today's vocabulary can carry completely. ⚠ `target` is the ally the Skill was AIMED at (M-35), which is what 「指定我方单体」 names; her Skill is a `Defence` skill, so it fires SKILL_CAST with no hit targets and this rule is the whole of its effect today. ⚠ `DISPEL` reaches **negative** buffs only, which is exactly what 「解除…1 个负面效果」 says (the five debuff classes answer `isDebuff()` in one table -- DebuffTest). ⚠ Her kit is written clause by clause, and what is NOT written is registered rather than approximated -- each blocked clause and the capability it needs: ① 战技的护盾 ✅ **WRITTEN** -- it is the first rule in this file (`scale: owner_def` + `amount: 760` + `turns: 3`); ② 战技的嘲讽 stayed out on purpose (the reason is in the shield rule's note: a soft weight with no magnitude, against a hard-lock op); ③ 终结技的冻结「有 50% 基础概率陷入冻结状态，持续 1 回合…每回合开始时受到等同于三月七 60% 攻击力的冰属性附加伤害」 -- 冻结 is a control state the engine deliberately does not model yet (P10-2 composes controls out of a StunBuff plus a speed debuff plus an action delay), so there is nothing for a rule to apply or to ask about; ④ 天赋「当**持有护盾的**我方目标受到敌方目标攻击后…立即向攻击者发起反击…每回合可触发 2 次」 ✅ **WRITTEN (2026-09-27)** -- it is the third rule in this file, and it needed exactly the two capabilities that were added for it: the `has_shield` condition and a per-turn **count** (`per_turn: 2`, because `cooldown: 1` can only ever say 「一次」 and a counter with no limit fires on every hit of a three-hit attack); ⑤ the rest is registered: 行迹「加护」 (护盾 +1 回合) and 星魂 6 (「在**战技提供的**护盾保护下的我方目标，每回合开始时回复 4% 生命上限 + 106」) both need the shield's **provider / an existing buff's duration** to be expressible -- the engine remembers the provider (`ShieldBuff.getSource()`) but no condition exposes it, and nothing can lengthen a buff that is already up; 星魂 2 (「进入战斗时，为当前生命值百分比**最低**的我方目标提供 24% 防御力 + 320 的护盾，持续 3 回合」) needs a 「生命百分比最低的队友」 **selector** (the DSL can compare HP, it cannot pick a minimum); 星魂 4 (「天赋的反击每回合可触发次数增加 1 次；反击伤害提高，提高数值等同于三月七防御力的 30%」) needs a passive that **raises another rule's limit** (a second rule with `per_turn: 3` would ADD firings rather than raise the cap) plus a damage **addend** derived from DEF; 星魂 1 (「终结技每冻结 1 个目标，为三月七恢复 6 点能量」) and 行迹「冰咒」 (+15% freeze chance) ride on ③; 星魂 3/5 are the skill-level gap already registered (M-32). ⚠ The 秘技 (100107) is a MAP attack -- the engine has no in-battle event for techniques, so it is out of scope rather than blocked.

source: 1001 三月七 天赋 少女的特权 (100104, 单体攻击/Ice): 「当持有护盾的我方目标受到敌方目标攻击后，三月七立即向攻击者发起反击，对其造成等同于三月七100%攻击力的冰属性伤害，该效果每回合可触发2次。」 param Lv10 = [1, 2] → #1 = 1（伤害倍率），#2 = 2（每回合可触发次数）
note: Every clause of this sentence is carried by one piece of vocabulary, and each piece is the one that makes a *different* wrong reading impossible. ① 「受到…攻击后」 is `TAKING_HIT`, not `HP_LOST`: TAKING_HIT fires whenever an incoming damage instance lands, **including when the shield absorbs all of it** (hpLoss == 0), and this talent is precisely about a shielded ally -- gating it on HP loss would have skipped the case it exists for. ② 「持有护盾的我方目标」 is `target has_shield`, read from the alive shield value (a shield that has been used up no longer qualifies). ⚠ 「我方」 is not a condition: TAKING_HIT is only ever delivered for a subject on our side (Battle.fireTriggersForAlly), which is why the event is the right one for this sentence and `HP_LOST` (either side) would not be. ③ 「受到**敌方目标**攻击」 is `!actor is_ally` -- the event's `actor` is the attacker, and without the condition a friendly-fire instance would be countered as well. ④ 「向攻击者发起反击」 is `target: "attacker"`. ⑤ 「每回合可触发2次」 is `per_turn: 2` (param #2), counted in **三月七's own** turns, exactly like `cooldown`: without it the counter would fire on every hit of a three-hit attack -- a wrong number with nothing to report. ⚠ It is the first user of both `has_shield` and `per_turn`. ⑥ The numbers are not written here: `skill: "TALENT"` + `damage_param: 0` + `damage_level: 10` reads 1 (100% ATK, the Lv10 row the prose quotes) and the Ice element and single-target shape come from 100104's own data. ⚠ `damage_level: 10` is required, not decoration: every skill in this engine is level 1, so the skill's own level would read 0.5 (50%) -- half the damage, with nothing to report (M-32). ⚠ 「反击也属于追加攻击」 holds automatically: `DAMAGE` settles through `Battle.applyAdditionalDamage`, the engine's one notion of a follow-up attack, which is also what emits FOLLOW_UP. ⚠ NOT authored: 星魂 4 raises this cap to 3 and adds 30% of her DEFENCE to the counter's damage -- a second rule with `per_turn: 3` would *add* firings rather than raise this rule's cap (there is no "modify another rule's limit" mechanism), and the damage addend is a derived flat value no op can express; 星魂 1 (energy per frozen target) and 行迹「冰咒」 (+15% freeze chance) need the freeze control state; 星魂 2 needs a 「生命值百分比最低的队友」 selector; 星魂 6 and 行迹「加护」 need the shield's provider / a way to lengthen a shield that is already up.
